title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
description: Link wakes after a century-long sleep and explores a ruined Hyrule to defeat Calamity Ganon.
facts: It launched on March 3, 2017, for both the Nintendo Switch and the Wii U.
Hidemaro Fujibayashi directed it and Eiji Aonuma produced it.
It won Game of the Year at The Game Awards 2017.
Its physics and chemistry systems let fire spread across grass and metal conduct lightning.
There are 900 hidden Korok seeds scattered across the map.
It is the first mainline Zelda with fully voiced major cutscenes, and Zelda is voiced by Patricia Summersett.
It was first revealed for the Wii U in 2013 and was delayed several times before launch.
The world contains 120 shrines, each a short puzzle or combat challenge.
Its sequel, Tears of the Kingdom, was released on May 12, 2023.
The soundtrack leans on sparse, quiet piano instead of constant sweeping orchestral themes.

title: Minecraft
description: A blocky open world where players gather resources, build structures and survive the night.
facts: Markus 'Notch' Persson released early versions in 2009, and the full game launched on November 18, 2011.
Microsoft bought Mojang, the studio behind it, in 2014 for about $2.5 billion.
It is the best-selling video game of all time, with over 300 million copies sold.
The Creeper came from a bug while Notch was trying to make a pig model.
Daniel Rosenfeld, known as C418, composed the original soundtrack.
An early development name for the game was 'Cave Game'.
The first MineCon convention was held in Las Vegas in November 2011.
Defeating the Ender Dragon triggers the credits, which include the 'End Poem' by Julian Gough.
Jens 'Jeb' Bergensten took over as lead developer after Notch stepped back.
A live-action Minecraft Movie arrived in 2025 and grossed more than $900 million.
